svg.title: Wiring MCP Servers into Claude Code
svg.desc: Team MCP servers go in the project .mcp.json, committed, with tokens read from environment variables, while personal servers live in ~/.claude.json; all servers' tools are discovered together, and resources expose content catalogs.
svg.text: Wiring MCP Servers into Claude Code
Shared servers in the repo, secrets in the environment, personal servers at home.
